article: Restart Windows Explorer in Windows 10 and 11
scope: Read and compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; verified Task Manager restart and Run new task procedures, process name, safety note, UI-label caveat, metadata dates, and the Microsoft Support link.
findings: Removed the obsolete Windows 10 taskbar hidden-menu instructions and replaced the Windows 11 claim based on that menu with the current cross-version Task Manager method.
Made Task Manager > Processes > Windows Explorer > Restart the recommended path and added Run new task > explorer.exe as the fallback when Explorer is absent.
Removed the forceful taskkill command and outdated embedded screenshots that no longer match the recommended workflow.
Corrected duplicate dates, preserved the original publication date (2024-03-30), and added lastmod (2026-11-25).
